title.zh: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
title.en: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin

current_state.zh: S&P Global 已同意收购 OpenZeppelin；OpenZeppelin 将作为独立业务部门运营，Demian Brener 留任 CEO 并向 Yann Le Pallec 汇报，交易财务条款未披露。
current_state.en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire OpenZeppelin; OpenZeppelin will operate as a separate business unit, with Demian Brener remaining CEO and reporting to Yann Le Pallec, and financial terms were not disclosed.

updates.title_zh: Financial Data Giant S&P Global Moves Deeper Into Crypto With OpenZeppelin Deal
updates.title_en: Financial Data Giant S&P Global Moves Deeper Into Crypto With OpenZeppelin Deal
updates.what_changed_zh: 收购后 OpenZeppelin 将作为 S&P Global 旗下独立业务部门继续运营，联合创始人兼 CEO Demian Brener 留任并直接向 S&P Global Ratings 总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报；交易财务条款未披露。
updates.what_changed_en: After the acquisition, OpenZeppelin will continue operating as a separate S&P Global business unit, with co-founder and CEO Demian Brener remaining in charge and reporting to S&P Global Ratings President Yann Le Pallec; financial terms were not disclosed.
updates.current_state_zh: S&P Global 已同意收购 OpenZeppelin；OpenZeppelin 将作为独立业务部门运营，Demian Brener 留任 CEO 并向 Yann Le Pallec 汇报，交易财务条款未披露。
updates.current_state_en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire OpenZeppelin; OpenZeppelin will operate as a separate business unit, with Demian Brener remaining CEO and reporting to Yann Le Pallec, and financial terms were not disclosed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to expand its risk assessment capabilities into the code underpinning tokenized financial products.
updates.detailed_summary_en: S&P Global has agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin to expand its risk assessment capabilities into the code underpinning tokenized financial products.
